name: Musubi dachi
motion_prompt: Stand upright, heels touching, toes turned out about 45 degrees in a V, arms relaxed at sides.

name: Heikō dachi
motion_prompt: Stand with feet parallel and shoulder width apart, knees softly bent, arms relaxed.

name: Sanchin dachi
motion_prompt: Move into Sanchin stance: right foot half-step forward, feet turned inward, knees drawn inward, pelvis tucked, fists at chest height.

name: Neko ashi dachi
motion_prompt: Shift roughly ninety percent of weight onto rear leg, lift front heel so only ball and toes touch, hands in open guard.

name: Shiko dachi
motion_prompt: Open into a deep wide stance with toes turned out 45 degrees, knees tracking over feet, thighs close to parallel, fists chambered.

name: Zenkutsu dachi
motion_prompt: Step into a long front stance, front knee bent above foot, rear leg straight, rear heel flat, torso upright.

name: Kōkutsu dachi
motion_prompt: Shift weight onto bent rear leg, rear foot turned outward, front leg nearly straight, torso side-on, head forward.

name: Tsuru ashi dachi
motion_prompt: Balance on one leg, lift the other foot to the inside of the supporting knee, raise one hand high and the other low.

name: Choku zuki
motion_prompt: From a chambered fist at the hip, drive the punching fist straight forward along the centre line, rotate to palm-down at impact, then retract to chamber.

name: Oi zuki
motion_prompt: Step forward into a front stance while punching with the arm on the same side as the advancing leg, then recover.

name: Gyaku zuki
motion_prompt: From front stance, rotate hips and drive the rear-side fist straight forward to impact, opposite hand retracts to hip, then return.

name: Kizami zuki
motion_prompt: From a fighting stance, snap the lead fist straight forward to head height and retract quickly while the rear hand guards the chin.

name: Mawashi zuki
motion_prompt: Swing the fist in a horizontal arc toward head height with the elbow lifted, contact from the side, then retract.

name: Ura zuki
motion_prompt: At close range, drive a short palm-up punch upward with the elbow close to the ribs, then return to chamber.

name: Uraken uchi
motion_prompt: Snap the back of the knuckles outward from a folded position across the chest toward head height, then retract.

name: Shutō uchi
motion_prompt: Swing an open knife hand from beside the ear toward a neck-height target, little-finger edge leading, thumb tucked, then retract.

name: Haitō uchi
motion_prompt: Sweep the open hand in a wide arc toward neck height, thumb-side edge leading, then recover.

name: Tettsui uchi
motion_prompt: Raise and drive a tight fist downward in a hammering arc, bottom edge of fist leading, then recover.

name: Empi uchi
motion_prompt: Rotate the torso and drive the point of the elbow forward at head height, arm folded tightly, then return.

name: Nukite
motion_prompt: Thrust the open hand straight forward at stomach height with fingers together and slightly bent, then retract.

name: Mae geri
motion_prompt: Chamber the knee, extend the lower leg straight forward with toes pulled back and ball of foot leading, then re-chamber and set down.

name: Mawashi geri
motion_prompt: Lift the knee out to the side, pivot the supporting foot, whip the shin around toward chest height with instep leading, then re-chamber.

name: Yoko geri
motion_prompt: Chamber the knee across the body, pivot supporting foot, drive the heel/outer blade sideways at hip height, then re-chamber.

name: Ushiro geri
motion_prompt: Turn the head to look back, chamber the knee and drive the heel straight backward at stomach height, then retract.

name: Hiza geri
motion_prompt: Drive the knee sharply upward to stomach height while pulling both hands downward as if controlling an opponent, then lower.

name: Kansetsu geri
motion_prompt: Lift and stamp the foot downward and forward toward knee height with controlled low-line power, then retract.

name: Kin geri
motion_prompt: Snap the lower leg upward to groin height with the instep/shin leading and minimal wind-up, then retract.

name: Age uke
motion_prompt: Raise the forearm diagonally above the forehead, finishing past the opposite temple, then return to guard.

name: Gedan barai
motion_prompt: Sweep the forearm down and across the body to finish above the leading thigh, then recover.

name: Soto uke
motion_prompt: Travel from outside the body inward across the centreline, finishing with forearm vertical and fist near head height.

name: Uchi uke
motion_prompt: Travel from near the body outward away from the centreline, finishing with forearm vertical and fist near head height.

name: Shutō uke
motion_prompt: From back stance, sweep the open knife hand into guard in front of the chest while the other open hand settles at solar plexus.

name: Mawashi uke
motion_prompt: Rotate both open hands in a coordinated circular motion, one hand finishing high by forehead and the other low by stomach.

name: Kake uke
motion_prompt: Hook the open hand sharply at the wrist to trap an incoming arm at chest height, then return to guard.
